description:
Open a security or operations incident. Privi starts the notification clocks for the rules you pick
(GDPR 72 hours, NIS2 24 hours / 72 hours / one month, SEC four business days, your contract's hours) and
writes the incident to your tamper-evident 'incidents' log. Requires the organization API key.

actor.description: Who is doing this (person or agent)
actor.title: Actor

aware_at.description: When you became aware (ISO 8601). Default: now
aware_at.title: Aware At

contract_hours.description: Hours your customer contracts give you to notify them
contract_hours.title: Contract Hours

material_at.description: SEC only: when you decided the incident was material
material_at.title: Material At

regimes.description: Notification rules that may apply: gdpr = EU GDPR Article 33 (personal data breach); nis2 = EU NIS2 Article 23 (significant incident); sec_8k = US SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05 (material cybersecurity incident)
regimes.title: Regimes

name: incident_open
title: Incident: open and start the clocks
